Name: Emily looks like Haley
Author: orochifrogu
Description:
I wanted to make Emily look more like her sister. Yet, I also tried to keep Emily's vanilla spirit. So I gave her the good 'ol fashion MAKEOVER a la Haley Style. What do you think? (^_−)☆

UPDATE: CHANGED HER REGULAR CLOTHING TO LOOK MORE LIKE HER SPRITE <3
[size=4]UPDATE: I made this [url=https://youtu.be/kyR9d2IHKEw]Youtube video[/url] showcasing this mod! <3 and also [url=https://youtube.com/shorts/Gt80UORJzwY]THIS YOUTUBE SHORT[/url]/ come over and check them out if you please! I'd love to hear what you think!
[/size]
This mod changes Emily's portraits, and her winter character sprite! I didn't touch her other two character sprites. 

If you like my mods, check out [url=http://www.youtube.com/@orochifrogu]my Youtube Channel[/url] where I post trailers/showcase videos of my mods!! I have two new videos coming tonight (May 20th), and one will be a youtube short for this mod <3

If you have any problems with the file, or any comments at all, [size=3]pls let me know in the comment section!!!![/size][size=2] I love seeing what you guys think and I will do all that I can to help fix any potential issues you may have!!!

[/size][size=4]WHAT ELSE AM I WORKING ON:

[/url]3. A secret project for frog-lovers!!
4. Next Bachelor for me to give portraits/sprites to will be Clint!! (watch out, Berserk fans!!)
